İSPARK Otopark Detay Bilgileri Web Servisi

description: İSPARK Inc.: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İSPARK Inc.. Coverage: İSPARK Inc.. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: ISPARK Parking Information; İSPARK Otopark Detay Bilgileri Web Servisi; Ispark Parking List Web Service. Formats seen: API, PDF, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
